problem.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II

approaches.title: Sum positive consecutive price gains
approaches.summary: Computes the maximum profit by summing every positive day-to-day price increase, which is optimal when unlimited transactions are allowed. Revision 2 expresses the same window-based calculation with iterator combinators.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Iterates over consecutive price pairs and accumulates each positive difference into the total profit.
Refactors the same consecutive-gain strategy into a concise iterator pipeline using map and sum.
